550:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... I cannot surrender this world to your ego...)

550:t_1:88.en:
$$テッサ$$
(We will stake our lives on preventing that.)

550:t_1:92.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

550:t_1:93.en:
$$カレン$$
「...So $$かなめ$$ is being targeted by $$アマルガム$$ because she has that 《$$ウィスパード$$》 power.」

550:t_1:95.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's the power to receive all kinds of information from the future...」

550:t_1:96.en:
$n
「So that changed the world from the way it was supposed to be.」

550:t_1:97.en:
$$スザク$$
「He intends to remake the world to correct that distortion...」

550:t_1:98.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan... In other words, it's his own selfish repair of space-time...」

550:t_1:99.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「So that $$時空震動弾$$ is part of the power he needs for it.」

550:t_1:101.en:
$$桂$$
(She really is a $$特異点$$... $$かなめ$$ must be the key to repairing space-time after all.)

550:t_1:104.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I can understand how he feels. But he is clinging to the past.」

550:t_1:105.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ once lost $$フィアナ$$ when her life ran out...」

550:t_1:106.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If $$キリコ$$ had sided with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and accepted the $$時の牢獄$$, $$フィアナ$$ might have survived...」

550:t_1:107.en:
$$カレン$$
「But $$キリコ$$ didn't choose that... He believes the past is the past...」

550:t_1:108.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is how humans should live.」

550:t_1:109.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is why we mourn the dead and fight to reach a better future, however slightly...」

550:t_1:110.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ asked me to convey her apology for concealing the $$ウィスパード$$, even if it was classified.」

550:t_1:111.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Did you know about it, Major $$オズマ$$?」

550:t_1:112.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Yeah, I did... $$ミスリル$$ informed officers of field rank and above as a matter of top secrecy.」

550:t_1:113.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But I want you to understand that we had no choice.」

550:t_1:114.en:
$n
「I don't mind. Whatever powers they have, $$千鳥$$ is still $$千鳥$$, and Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ is still Captain $$テスタロッサ$$.」

550:t_1:115.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... Our friend was kidnapped, so we're going to save her. That's all there is to it.」

550:t_1:118.en:
$$アルト$$
(You carried this secret alone while fighting to protect $$かなめ$$...?)

550:t_1:119.en:
$n
(You were also protecting $$千鳥$$ from being treated as someone special.)

550:t_1:120.en:
$n
(So she could someday live a life where those powers didn't matter...)

550:t_1:121.en:
$$オズマ$$
「And she is the key to $$アマルガム$$'s... no, $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan.」

550:t_1:122.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Our objective is to bring her back. Remember that.」

550:t_1:124.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「...But what I don't understand is what the $$クロノ$$ Reformists are thinking.」

550:t_1:125.en:
$$レド$$
「What were they trying to achieve by destroying $$ヤムスク$$?」

550:t_1:126.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I think it was to stop $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s plan, but...」

550:t_1:127.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then they should fight properly instead of doing things halfway...」

550:t_1:128.en:
$$桂$$
「Knowing $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, he may have decided to sit back and watch from above.」

550:t_1:129.en:
$$桂$$
「And that power of his... It might belong to something beyond human, what they call a higher-dimensional life-form.」

550:t_1:130.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Has he... really become our enemy after all...?」

550:t_1:131.en:
$$桂$$
「Come on, $$ミレーヌ$$. Do you still trust him?」

550:t_1:132.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That isn't it, but I just can't believe he's a bad person...」

550:t_1:133.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I can understand how you feel.」

550:t_1:134.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Do you feel that way too, $$クロウ$$?」

550:t_1:135.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I can't really explain it, but part of me wants to trust $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

550:t_1:136.en:
$$クラン$$
「Could that man... be putting us through a trial?」

550:t_1:137.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A trial, huh... We could do without his help.」

550:t_1:138.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But thinking of it that way makes some things add up.」

550:t_1:139.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even if that's true, $$テッサ$$ and $$宗介$$ could have died because of the Reformists if things went wrong.」

550:t_1:140.en:
$$カレン$$
「And it wasn't their fault, but in that battle, $$クルツ$$...」

550:t_1:142.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$クルツ$$... He was always cheerful and lifted everyone's spirits...」

550:t_1:143.en:
$$レド$$
「In a situation like this, his wisecracks were all the more reassuring...」

550:t_1:144.en:
$$ミシェル$$
(I've lost... another sniper I looked up to...)

550:t_1:145.en:
$$クロウ$$
(You went and left the woman you loved behind... You really were born to draw the short straw, $$クルツ$$...)

550:t_1:146.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even if they weren't directly responsible, I can't forgive what the Reformists did...」

550:t_1:147.en:
$$桂$$
「And I don't like how he treated $n as his property either.」

550:t_1:149.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Leave him be. ...Apparently, he... ran into that ex-girlfriend at $$ヤムスク$$.」

550:t_1:151.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you thinking about that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ person?」

550:t_1:152.en:
$n
「I think there's no point in thinking about him.」

550:t_1:153.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then what are you thinking about?」

550:t_1:155.en:
$n
($$クルツ$$... You've looked after me ever since before $c existed...)

550:t_1:156.en:
$n
(Your backup let me manage to fight even though I was an amateur...)

550:t_1:157.en:
$n
(Thank you, $$クルツ$$... I will never forget you.)

550:t_1:158.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Do you still love $$マキ#pilot$$?」

550:t_1:160.en:
$n
「But... $$マキ#pilot$$ really did help me when I was going through a hard time.」

550:t_1:161.en:
$n
「Even if $$マキ#pilot$$ approached me on a $$クロノ$$ mission, I won't forget that.」

550:t_1:162.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You're fortunate, $n, with people like $$マキ#pilot$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ around you.」

550:t_1:163.en:
$n
「I'm grateful to you too, $$ティティ$$.」

550:t_1:164.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Even if you're just flattering me, it makes me happy to hear that.」

550:t_1:165.en:
$n
(Thanks to my friends, I was able to get back on my feet...)

550:t_1:166.en:
$n
($$宗介$$... I'm counting on you to take care of $$マオ$$.)

550:t_1:170.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Mess Hall～
